## Bachelor's and Master's theses

I have supervised 12 Bachelor's theses (TFG), including six associated with *Becas de Colaboración*, and four Master's theses (TFM).

## Teaching materials

Lecture notes, problem collections and computational demonstrations will be offered selectively, each with its own version information and rights notice. The website will not serve as a public repository of unpublished research material.

For selected computational resources, see [Mathematica notebooks](mathematica.qmd) and the [copyright policy](copyright.qmd).

## Prospective students

If you are interested in a Bachelor's or Master's thesis, a *Beca de Colaboración* or a PhD on spectral theory, quantum fields or Casimir physics, write to me at [jose.munoz.castaneda@uva.es](mailto:jose.munoz.castaneda@uva.es).
